title: Importing routines from a Hevy share link opens Hevy's web page inside the app, and the privacy notice does not name Hevy
what: When a member pastes a Hevy share link, the app quietly opens Hevy's public web page in a hidden in-app browser and reads the routines off it. That page load sends the phone's internet address and device details to Hevy (and to anything Hevy's page itself loads). No Hevy account is used and nothing the member logged is sent, but the privacy notice's list of outside companies does not mention Hevy or that the app opens its page.
expected: The privacy notice says that importing from a Hevy link opens Hevy's own page from the phone, so Hevy sees the phone's address, in English and Hindi.
who: members who import routines from a Hevy link
fix_line: Add one line to the privacy notice (both languages) that a Hevy link import opens Hevy's page from the phone.

items.reason: 4 promises read in code, all kept. P-A7-phone-watch-3-14: the saved end is start plus time trained, paused time left out (savedEnd used when the workout is saved). P-A7-phone-watch-3-18: Workout sounds off sends 'quiet', and the native side then uses a vibrate-only channel with no sound. P-A7-phone-watch-3-10: Discard clears the open workout's only stored copy (the draft) and the ticked-set count shown comes from the same sets. P-A7-phone-watch-3-17: barbell jumps step by the gym's plate set (gym plate helpers), smallest plate pair when nothing above. No promise broken.

This area keeps everything on the phone: profile, progress and workout photos are copied into the app's own folders, share text leaves out body weight and name, routine share goes through the phone's share menu the member picks. Notice duty gap: the opt-in photo backup copies progress photos to the member's Google backup while the notice says they never leave the phone (reused FN-A5-phone-screens-2-1b-01). Hevy link import not in the notice (01). No children or consent logic in this area.

No file in this area talks to the MettleUp server or database: a search for supabase, fetch and outside addresses finds only the Hevy page link. Nothing here reaches MettleUp staff, so there is no read log to check.

Nothing kept past its time here: a new profile photo deletes the old file; deleting a progress photo deletes the row, the file and its backup copy; a deleted workout takes its photos; routine share files sit in the share folder that Erase all data empties.

Outside sends from this area: (a) the opt-in 'Include photos in my backup' puts progress photos in the folder Android backs up to the member's Google account, against the notice line 'Your progress photos never leave your phone' (reused FN-A5-phone-screens-2-1b-01); (b) a Hevy link import loads Hevy's page from the phone, Hevy not named (01). No AI, WhatsApp, analytics or Health Connect calls in these files; share text and routine share go only through the phone's share menu.

Account delete is on the server, not here. Erase all data on the phone: the photo erase steps delete the progress, photo-backup and profile photo folders, the picker and share temp folders and the image caches; workout photos are an erase step of their own. Copies already in the member's Google Android backup are not reached by an erase (same root as the reused photo-backup finding). A real erase was not run (needs a phone).
